scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=skills/pharos-rwa-manager/cli.js --banner:js=$'#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport { createRequire as __cr } from \'node:module\'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);' --define:__VERSION__="\"$npm_package_version\"" --define:__OWNER__='"jason-pharos"' --define:__REPO__='"pharos-rwa-skill"' && chmod +x skills/pharos-rwa-manager/cli.js
scripts.dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp skills/pharos-rwa-manager/cli.js dist/cli.js && shasum -a 256 dist/cli.js | awk '{print $1}' > dist/cli.js.sha256 && shasum -a 256 skills/pharos-rwa-manager/SKILL.md | awk '{print $1}' > dist/SKILL.md.sha256 && printf 'v%s\n' "$npm_package_version" > dist/VERSION
scripts.release:gh: npm run dist && gh release create v$npm_package_version --title v$npm_package_version --generate-notes dist/cli.js dist/cli.js.sha256 skills/pharos-rwa-manager/SKILL.md dist/SKILL.md.sha256 dist/VERSION
